entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I need to return a VeloBand GPS tracker.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Jane Smith, order number 94-Alpha-3. I'm busy, so just tell me yes or no, can I return it?
I understand completely, Ms. Smith. To make sure I handle this correctly, I just need to ask, is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue with the band?
It's a preference. The interface is **confusing** and frankly **hard to use**. I read the **user manual** twice and I just can't get it to do what I want. I really **expected more** from it.
I see, thank you for clarifying. Let me just pull up your order details... Okay, I see you received the item 26 days ago. One moment while I check the return policy for you.
Alright, I've checked. Our policy allows for returns on items within 90 days of delivery. So yes, you are well within the timeframe to make a return.

Yes. I've just initiated the return authorization. I am emailing you a pre-paid shipping label right now. Please pack the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any postal service location.
I have the email. Okay, that's it then. Thanks.
You're welcome. Once our warehouse receives the item, a full refund will be issued to your original form of payment. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
